subject: general
question: A horse racecourse is in the form of an annular ring whose outer and inner circumferences are 748 m and 396 m, respectively. The width (in m) of the racecourse is: (Take π = (22)/(7))
solution:
Given:

The horse racecourse is in the form of an annular ring whose outer and inner circumferences are 748 m and 396 m.

Concept used:

Circumference of a circle = 2π × (Radius)

Calculation:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cddf503a09188acc8beda21dbf7168aa7b2203ec5a44125919fc2b10e1457eec.png] 

Inner radius of the racecourse = 396 ÷ (2π) = 63m

Outer radius of the racecourse = 748 ÷ (2π) = 119m

Hence, the width of the racecourse = 119 - 63 = 56m

**∴ The width of the racecourse is 56m.**
